Joseon sumi ink, vertical layering in a 2:1 frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop. ONE device: three horizontal bands divided by flying-white dry-brush strokes. At the top centre, huge and calm above the clouds, the old Creator Hannim, robes splashed in black ink. Below him on the left the land of the living: tiny mountains and a river, Little Star standing over it. On the right the land of the dead: a black mass of ink with a faint gate, Big Star standing over it. Between and beyond them to the west, a field of flowers in one translucent pale-red wash, the only colour. Mortals nowhere; gods may fill the frame. FULL-BLEED, no paper margin. REFERENCE SHEET. TOP ROW, left to right: LEFT face = hwanin, SECOND face = sobyeol, THIRD face = daebyeol. Copy each face exactly; give each person the dress the scene names. SMALLER SECOND ROW, left to right: costume chart (cut and shape only; ignore its labels, poses and faces). MYTH INK — this beat is myth, not history, so it is painted as a STRIKING Korean ink painting (sumukhwa), not the house colour style. Joseon sumi ink on raw hanji paper with EXTREME LIGHT AGAINST DARK: huge saturated masses of black ink set against blinding bare paper; light is always the unpainted paper itself, never painted white; almost no mid-grey; hard edges where light meets dark, wet bleeding edges everywhere else. Splashed ink (pomuk), dry-brush flying white, ink spatter, mist left as untouched paper. Monumental emptiness and ONE graphic device carrying the frame; a dramatic angle (worm’s-eye, bird’s-eye, dutch). Gods, giants, beasts and wonders may fill the frame; mortals stay small inside the wonder. Figures in confident calligraphic brush line; named faces match the attached portraits, translated into a few ink strokes. Black ink and paper only, except at most ONE small translucent wash of a single colour on the one symbolic object the scene names. Not photoreal, not webtoon shading, not watercolor landscape, not oil, no glow, no halo. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. No text, no calligraphy, no seal stamp, no watermark.
